linux_prep_fix_body_wizard: Ku veka khompyuta leyi eka SP Flash Tool, phaswedi ya wena yi ta laveka eka goza leri landzelaka ku lulamisa milawu ya USB na ku engetela akhawunti ya wena eka mintlawa ya vatirhisi va serial leyi lavekaka. Loko u ala, xikombelo xi ta pfala.
linux_prep_needs_access: Ku fikelela a ku nyikiwanga, ku flashing swi lava swona.
linux_prep_fixed: Ku fikelela ku nyikiwile, Xitirhisiwa xa SP Flash xi lunghekile.

linux_prep_reboot_done_btn: Swi endliwile, Pfala App ku Sungula Khomphyuta Hi Vuntshwa
settings_driver_desc: Loko u nga si tirhisa app ro sungula, u fanele ku nghenisa muchayeri wa USB wa MediaTek, kutani u pfula khompyuta ya wena nakambe.
home_desc: Kuma firmware eka inthanete kutani u hlawula phasela ra laha kaya, kutani u yi flash eka xitirhisiwa xa wena.

home_step_4: Tima gezi u tlhela u hlanganisa USB

sel_install_from_file: Ku nghenisa ku suka eka fayili...
settings_advanced_desc: Ku kombisa ndlela yo nghenisa, movha wo nghenisa na swisefo swo humesa.
settings_track_multiple_toggle: Remind me about multiple releases on a single model
settings_track_multiple_desc: Keeps a record of every release installed on the same model. With more than one on record the app cannot tell your players apart, so an install asks which software is running and whether to keep your settings and media. Player update reminders keep working as usual.
settings_track_multiple_warn_body: With more than one release tracked for a model, every install for that model asks which software is on the player and whether to keep your settings and media, because the app cannot tell one player from another. Player update reminders keep working as usual.
settings_guided_install: Ndzi kongomise hi ku install eka app
settings_guided_install_desc: App yi tshama na wena hi ku tima gezi, ku hlanganisa na ku nghenisa.
settings_terminal_install: Nghenisa ku suka eka fasitere ra theminali
settings_sp_gui_install: Nghenisa eka SP Flash Tool GUI
settings_sp_gui_desc: Ku pfala Updater na ku pfula SP Flash Tool GUI na fayili yo hangalasa ya firmware leyi hlawuriweke na swifaniso swa xiphemu leswi layichiweke ka ha ri emahlweni.
settings_terminal_desc: Ku fambisa software installation ya wena eka Terminal leswaku u ta kota ku vona technical info eka nhluvuko.
settings_terminal_desc_windows: Ku fambisa ku nghenisiwa ka wena ka software eka Command Prompt leswaku u ta kota ku vona vuxokoxoko bya xithekiniki eka nhluvuko.
settings_sp_auth_desc: Hlawula. Swikongomelo swin’wana swa MediaTek swi ala ku flash ku kondza Xitirhisiwa xa SP Flash xi nyikiwa fayili ya vuhlayiseki (.auth); engetela ya wena laha loko xitirhisiwa xi lava xin’we.
terminal_install_no_scatter: Ku hava fayili ya ku hangalaka leyi kumiweke eka phasela leri, hikwalaho a ku na xileriso xa console lexi nga akiwa.
terminal_install_no_tool: Ku hava SP Flash Tool build kumbe MTKClient entry point leyi kumekaka eka ndlela leyi.
terminal_install_failed: A swi swi kotanga ku pfula fasitere ra theminali. Xileriso xo nghenisa xi tsariwile eka {path}.
status_terminal_install: Xileriso xo nghenisa lexi pfuriweke eka fasitere ra wena ra theminali ({path}).
terminal_install_prompt_body:
{terminal_name} sweswi yi ta pfula yi tsutsuma {method}.

• Loko yi nga si tima, tima {device} ya wena.
• Loko yi hlanganisiwe na USB, rhanga hi ku yi tsema.
{hint} .
• Hlanganisa xitirhisiwa xa wena na khompyuta ya wena loko fasitere ra {terminal_name} ri pfulekile.

Click OK ku sungula no huma eka Updater.
terminal_hint_innioasis: • Xitsundzuxo: Loko xitirhisiwa xi nga hlanganisi hi xoxe, cinca hi vukheta buti ya reset eka pinhole hi paperclip loko u ri karhi u hlanganisa khebulu ya USB.
terminal_hint_generic: • Xitsundzuxo: Veka xitirhisiwa xa wena eka movha wo dawuniloda firmware (swi hambana hi modele: e.g. susa betri ivi u yi hlayisa yi nga ngheni loko khebulu ya USB yi hlanganisiwile, kumbe u tima gezi loko betri yi nghenile, kumbe u khoma Volume Down/Up loko u ri karhi u hlanganisa USB).
sp_gui_install_prompt_title: Nghenisa hi ku tirhisa SP Flash Tool GUI
sp_gui_install_prompt_body:
SP Flash Tool GUI sweswi yi ta pfula na firmware ya wena leyi layichiweke ka ha ri emahlweni.

• Eka SP Flash Tool, hlawula "Download" eka bokisi leri nga ehansi.
• Click eka "Download" button.
• Tiyisisa leswaku {device} ya wena yi timiwile naswona yi hambanisiwile.
{hint} .
• Hlanganisa khebulu ya USB eka khompyuta ya wena endzhaku ko tikhoma Download.

Click OK ku sungula SP Flash Tool ivi u huma eka Updater.
settings_install_themes_desc: Loko swi pfuriwile, tinhlokomhaka ta Rockbox ti hundziseriwa hi ku tisungulela eka Y1 na Y2 endzhaku ka ku nghenisiwa ka Rockbox loku humeleleke.
themes_placement_failed_note: Hi tsandzekile ku veka themes pack eka player ya wena. U nga ringeta nakambe ku suka eka Switirhisiwa.
settings_rockbox_desc: Yi tirhisiwa loko u pfula ti-software leti humesiweke.
settings_filter_original_pre307: Kombisa minkandziyiso ya Software ya Masungulo ya khale ku tlula 3.0.7
settings_original_pre307_warn_body:
Ti original Software releases ta khale ku tlula 3.0.7 a ti fambisani na ti Y1 units leti xavisiwaka na Innioasis OS 3.0.7. Ku flasha build ya khale eka ti units leti swi ta ti sivela ku sungula ku kondza ku nghenisiwa version leyintshwa.

Xana u tiyisile leswaku u lava ku kombisa ti-Original Software releases ta khale ku tlula 3.0.7?
settings_filter_old_rockbox: Kombisa Swiaki swa Khale swa Rockbox
settings_240p_tip: Ku kombisa ti builds leti ROM zip ya tona yi nga 240p variant (rom..._240p.zip). 240p builds a yi fambisani na ti Y1 units eka Innioasis OS ehansi ka 3.0.7, hikokwalaho Show Old Rockbox Builds yi pfuriwile na yona.
settings_old_rockbox_warn_title: Xitsundzuxo xa ku fambisana ka Rockbox
settings_old_rockbox_warn_body:
Ku humesiwa ka Rockbox-Y1 emahlweni ka 0.5 a swi fambisani na tiyuniti ta Y1 leti xavisiweke endzhaku ka Dzivamisoko 2026 na Innioasis OS 3.0.7 leyi nghenisiweke ka ha ri emahlweni.

Ku flasha build ya khale eka switirhisiwa leswi swi ta sivela ku pfula.

Xana u tiyisile leswaku u lava ku kombisa ti build ta khale ta Rockbox?

sel_multiple_scatters_error: Tiphakeji to tala ta firmware kumbe tifayela to hangalasa ti kumiwile eka folda/archive leyi. Hi kombela u hlawula folda kumbe akhavhiyu leyi nga na phasela rin’we ntsena ra firmware hi nkarhi wun’we.

Hi kombela u tsema USB, pfula gezi ivi u pfula eka Rockbox kan’we (leswaku yi sungula folda ya yona ya le ndzeni ya .rockbox system), kutani u hlanganisa USB nakambe ivi u hlawula ‘USB Storage Mode’.

support_story_1_headline: Loko vaendli va swilo va ya emahlweni, vaaki va tlakuka.
support_story_1_lead: Ku sirhelela xitirhisiwa xa wena eka swirhalanganyi swa hardware leswi nga vulavuriki na ku pfuxetiwa loku tshovekeke.
support_story_1_body: Innioasis yi tshamela ku humesa ti firmwares letintshwa eka vatlangi vo fana na Y1 (ku kongomisa eka ku pfuxetiwa ka bodo loku fihliweke ku fana na 6.0, 7.0, na 8.0) loku tshovaka switirhisiwa swa khale hi ku miyela. Lexi biheke ngopfu, webusayiti ya vona yi nyika switsundzuxo swa zero na mfikelelo wa zero eka ti firmwares leti tirhaka ta khale ku vuyelela eka xiyimo xa switina. Updater na phurojeke ya Community Firmware va teka swiphemu: hi hlayisa ROM yin’wana na yin’wana ya xitoko xa ndzhaka, hi tiyisisa hi ku tisungulela ku pfuxetiwa ka wena ka hardware, naswona hi hlayisa xitlangi xa wena xi tirha hi ku hlayiseka.
support_story_1_item_1: Ku Ponisa Vatlangi Lava Broken: Ku kamberiwa ka vuhlayiseki ku tiyisisa leswaku ku pfuxetiwa lokuntshwa a ku si tshama ku brick hardware ya khale.
support_story_1_item_2: Archived Stock ROMs: Nhlengeleto lowu heleleke wa ti firmware ta fektri ta masungulo Innioasis yi susiwile.
support_story_1_item_3: Native Cross-Platform: Switirhisiwa swo voninga leswi heleleke swa macOS, Linux, na Windows hi ku fanana.
support_story_1_item_4: Vutlhari bya Hardware: Ku kumiwa ka bodo hi ku tisungulela leswaku u tshama u kuma phasela leri faneleke.
support_story_2_headline: Ku hava ti Google Drives leti tshovekeke. Ku hava ku ringanyeta-ku tirha. Ntsena ku tirha firmware.
support_story_2_lead: Switirhisiwa swa vaaki swa rivilo lerikulu, leswi tiyisisiweke leswi entiyisweni u nga titshegaka ha swona.
support_story_2_body: Ku landzelerisa software ya ximfumo ya Innioasis hi ntolovelo swi vula ku hlota tiforamu ku kuma swihlanganisi swa Google Drive leswi hundzeriweke hi nkarhi, ku avelana ka mapapa ya Baidu lama feke, na tifayela ta zip ta xihundla leti nga riki na switirhisiwa leswi voningaka. Hi ake netiweke yo dawuniloda leyi tshembekaka, leyi tiyimeleke leyi nga na vutshembeki bya SHA-256 lebyi tiyisisiweke, switiviso swo pfuxeta, na ku nghenisa loku kongomisiweke hi magoza hi magoza. Minyikelo ya n’wina hi ku kongoma yi hlayisa ku dawuniloda ni ku rhurhela loku endlaka leswaku leswi swi koteka tiawara ta 24 hi siku, masiku ya 365 hi lembe.
support_story_2_item_1: CDN ya Rivilo ra le Henhla hi ku Kongoma: Ku dawuniloda hi ku hatlisa, hi ku kongoma ku nga ri na swipimelo swo dawuniloda kumbe swihlanganisi leswi feke.
support_story_2_item_2: Switiviso swa Ndzulamiso: Titsundzuxiwa hi nkarhi lowu ku humesiwa lokuntshwa ka vaaki kumbe ku lulamisiwa ku welaka ha wona.
support_story_2_item_3: Ku Nghenisiwa ka Goza hi Goza leri Kongomisiweke: Switsundzuxo leswi vonakaka leswi nga erivaleni swi ku fambisa eka ku cinca kun’wana ni kun’wana ka buti.
support_story_2_item_4: Vaaki va Tindzimi to Tala: Ku hlanganisiwa hi ku helela hi Xinghezi, Xichayina, Xijarimani, Xipaniya, Xifurwa & Xijapani.
support_story_3_headline: Ku pfula vuswikoti lebyi heleleke bya mutlangi wa wena wa Innioasis.
support_story_3_lead: Ku tisa Rockbox, tisisiteme to tirha to olova ta ntolovelo, na ntshunxeko wa audiophile.
support_story_3_body: Software ya fektri ya xitoko yi khwaxa ntsena ehenhla ka leswi hardware ya wena ya Y1 kumbe Y2 yi nga swi endlaka. Vaaki va hina va tise Rockbox, tisisiteme to tirha ta ntolovelo to vevuka, ku tlangiwa ka codec ya audiophile, na tinhlokomhaka ta ntolovelo evuton’wini. Hi xava ku hambana ka hardware ya xiviri hi xikhwama ku kambela, ku tlherisela endzhaku, na ku tiyisisa ku nghenisa kun’wana na kun’wana. Ku seketela Updater hi ku kongoma swi seketela hi timali tiyuniti leti ta swikambelo naswona swi hatlisisa nhluvukiso wa firmware ya ntolovelo.
support_story_3_item_1: Rockbox ya Click One: Ku tlanga ka audiophile na tinhlokomhaka ta ntolovelo leti nghenisiweke hi tisekoni.
support_story_3_item_2: Firmware ya Vaaki: Ku antswisiwa ka betri, UI leyi tengeke, na nseketelo wa codec ya mpfumawulo ya manguva lawa.
support_story_3_item_3: Active Hardware Lab: Hi kambela eka switirhisiwa swa xiviri swa xiviri hi nga si humesa ku aka kwihi na kwihi.
support_story_3_item_4: Zero Bloatware: 100% ya mahala, software yo sungula ya vuhlayiseki leyi nga riki na swinavetiso kumbe ku landzelerisa.
support_story_4_headline: Hi pfuneni ku endla leswi Innioasis yi nga swi endliki.
support_story_4_lead: Ku hlayisiwa ka firmware leyi fambiwaka hi vaaki ku hlayisa switirhisiwa swa wena ehandle ka tindhawu to lahlela thyaka.
support_story_4_body: Loko khampani ya ti- hardware yi ya eka xitirhisiwa xa yona lexi landzelaka, timodeli ta khale ta tshikiwa. Innioasis a yi nyiki nseketelo wa Linux, ku hava ti changelogs leti nga erivaleni, naswona a yi nyiki ndlela yo olova yo vuyisa loko ku nghenisa ku tsandzeka. Updater yi kona hikuva vatirhisi lava hisekelaka etlhelo a va fanelanga ku lahla xichayachayani xa vuyimbeleri lexinene hi ku hetiseka. 100% wa tihakelo ta vaaki ti nghena hi ku kongoma eka ku hlayisa xitirhisiwa lexi xi pfulekele un’wana na un’wana.
support_story_4_item_1: Rescue & Unbrick: Ku vuyisa loku tiyisisiweke ku khuluka hambiloko switirhisiwa swi ala ku pfula.
support_story_4_item_2: Nseketelo wa Tlilasi yo Sungula ya Linux: MediaTek leyi seketeriwaka hi ku helela yi voninga eka ti-distro ta Linux.
support_story_4_item_3: Transparent Changelogs: Tinhlamuselo ta vuxokoxoko bya ku humesiwa leswaku u tiva kahle leswaku i yini lexi cincaka.
support_story_4_item_4: 100% Community Funded: Kofi yin’wana na yin’wana yi hlayisa archive yi pfulekile naswona ya mahala eka hinkwavo.

• Loko yi nga si tima, tima {label} ya wena.
• Loko yi hlanganisiwe na USB, rhanga hi ku yi tsema.
• Eka SP Flash Tool, tinya Download.

Kutani hlanganisa khebulu ya USB leswaku u sungula ku voninga.
sel_type_help_body:
Ringeta ku sungula Software ya Sisiteme ya Type A.

Loko vhilwa ra wena ro rhendzeleka ri nga hlamuli endzhaku ko nghenisa, nghenisa yin’wana ya tindlela ta Muxaka wa B.

Switirhisiwa swa muxaka wa B hi leswi a swi ta na tivhidiyo ta firmware ta le mahlweni ka 2.0.
sel_install_tooltip_generic: Nghenisa software ya sisiteme leyi hlawuriweke eka xitirhisiwa xa wena
dl_resuming_fmt: Ku sungula nakambe ku dawuniloda ku suka eka {mb} MB...
dl_retry_fmt: Ku hlanganisiwa ku kavanyetiwile. Ku ringeta nakambe ({attempt}/{max})...
linux_engine_staged_desc: MediaTek SP Flash Tool yi endliwe hi xiteji na ku fambisana ka libpng12.
linux_engine_recheck_desc: Click Re-check kumbe u tlhela u sungula setup ku download package.
linux_usb_rules_active_desc: Milawu ya MediaTek yi tirha (/etc/udev/rules.d/). Ku nghena ka desktop ku tirhisiwile.
linux_usb_grant_desc: Nyika mpfumelelo kan’we leswaku app yi ta kota ku vulavurisana na xitirhisiwa xa wena.
linux_perms_ok_msg: Mpfumelelo wa USB & milawu ya udev yi nghenisiwile hi ndlela leyi humelelaka. Vukorhokeri byi lulamisiwile.
linux_copied_msg_fmt:
Xileriso xa ku veka xi kopiwile eka clipboard:

{cmd} .

Tirhisa leswi eka theminali ku nghenisa milawu na ku layicha udev nakambe.
donate_rely_on_you: Hi pfuneni hi tihakelo ta hina to tsutsuma, nyikela namuntlha.
flash_sp_gui_tooltip: Pfula MediaTek SP Xitirhisiwa xa Flash GUI
status_install_ok_fmt: {software} yi nghenisiwile hi ndlela leyi humelelaka. {steps} Xitsonga.
status_app_reset_defaults: App yi tlheriseriwa hi ku helela eka defaults, download cache yi basisiwile, naswona xitsundzuxo xa betri xi vuyisiwile.
log_app_reset_defaults: Ku lulamisiwa ka app ku tlheriseriwe hi ku helela eka leswi nga riki swa xiviri, cache yo dawuniloda yi basisiwile, naswona xitsundzuxo xa betri xi vuyisiwile (R).
flash_watch_waiting: Ku yimela leswaku mutlangi wa wena a sungula nakambe...
flash_watch_waiting_hint: Yi hlayise yi plugged in, Rockbox yi sungula ku tirha naswona ti themes ta yona ti ta engeteriwa hi ku tisungulela.
flash_watch_found: Mutlangi u kumiwile, a engetela tinhlokomhaka ta Rockbox...
flash_watch_timeout: Mutlangi wa wena a nga si vuya.
flash_watch_timeout_hint: Languta leswaku yi nghenisiwile naswona yi pfuriwile. Loko ku tshama ku ri munyama, cinca pini eka khumbi ro tlherisela endzhaku ivi u khoma buti ya le xikarhi (Y1) kumbe buti ya gezi (vatlangi van’wana) leswaku u yi sungula nakambe. Loko ya ha ta sungula, firmware a yi teki, nghenisa yin’wana.
action_brom_detected: Xitirhisiwa xi kumiwile eka movha wa BROM...
action_flash_complete: Flash yi helerile! Hluvula USB ivi u tlhela u pfula.
task_writing_system: Ku tsala software ya sisiteme leyikulu
task_writing_user_storage: Ku tsala xiphemu xa vuhlayiselo bya mutirhisi
task_writing_partition_table: Ku tsala xivumbeko xa xiphemu xa xitirhisiwa
task_writing_partition_generic: Xiphemu xa firmware ya xitirhisiwa xo tsala
action_recover_powercycle: Power-cycle xitlangi (khoma matimba ~10s), kutani u xi hlanganisa nakambe - u ringeta nakambe...
action_wait_mtk: Ku yimele xitirhisiwa xa MTK... Tima xitirhisiwa xa gezi ivi u hlanganisa USB.
action_da_stall: Xitirhisiwa xi yime ku hlamula loko xi ri karhi xi lulamisa muyimeri wo dawuniloda. Yi tima hi ku helela, yi hlanganisa nakambe ivi u ringeta nakambe.
action_detected_brom: Xitirhisiwa xi kumiwile (mode ya BROM) - ku lulamisa muyimeri wo dawuniloda...
action_detected_preloader: Xitirhisiwa xi kumiwile (mode ya preloader) - ku lulamisa muyimeri wo dawuniloda...
action_da_wait_back: Mutlangi u tshike ku hlamula loko a ri karhi a sungula xitirhisiwa xo dawuniloda. Ku yimela leswaku yi vuya...
action_device_connected: Xitirhisiwa xi hlanganisiwile - ku lunghiselela swileriso swo tsala...
action_install_in_progress: Ku nghenisa swi le ku endliweni
action_restart_brom: Ku sungula nakambe xichayachayani eka movha wa BROM...
log_install_writing: Install in Progress - ku tsala swifaniso swa firmware...
log_sparse_fmt: Ku kumiwile xifaniso xa Android sparse xa {part}, ku hundzuluxa in-process...
err_code_connection_failed: A swi swi kotanga ku hlanganisa na xitirhisiwa
err_code_mtk_import_failed: MTKClient a yi swi kotanga ku layicha
err_code_sp_not_found: SP Flash Tool a yi kumeki
err_code_no_scatter: Ku hava fayili yo hangalasa eka phasela
err_code_missing_images: Swifaniso swa firmware leswi kayivelaka eka phasela
err_code_partition_table_invalid: Ku tiyisisiwa ka tafula ra ku avanyisa ku tsandzekile endzhaku ko tsala
err_sp_wrong_model: U hlanganisile modele leyi hoxeke ya mutlangi. Click × button ku khansela install leyi, kutani u hlawula software ya player leyi u yi hlanganiseke.
err_sp_timeout: Xitirho lexi a xi si tshama xi vona mutlangi. Yi hlayise yi timiwile naswona yi susiwile, kutani u hlanganisa khebulu ya USB loko u komberiwa.
err_sp_brom_startcmd: Mutlangi u pfuxe matimba ka ha ri ni nkarhi swinene. Yi tima gezi hi ku helela, kutani u tlhela u yi hlanganisa.
err_sp_download_fail: Ku tsala ku kavanyetiwile. Languta khebulu ya USB na port na ku chaja ka betri, kutani u ringeta nakambe.
err_sp_da_init_sync: Muyimeri wa ku dawuniloda a nga swi kotanga ku sungula. Ringeta ndlela yin’wana ya flash.
err_sp_brom_da_fail: Muyimeri wo dawuniloda a nga swi kotanga ku rhumeriwa eka xichayachayani. Yi tima gezi ivi u tlhela u hlanganisa.
err_sp_da_invalid_type: Mutlangi u arile muyimeri wo dawuniloda (xihoxo xa 6104). Tirhisa Download Agent leyi hlanganisiweke na SP Flash Tool, naswona kambela leswaku firmware yi fambelana na xichayachayani lexi.
err_sp_com_port: Xitirhisiwa lexi a xi nga swi koti ku pfula xipfalo xa xona xa serial. Pfala switirhisiwa swin’wana leswi voningaka ivi u hlanganisa nakambe.
err_com_port_reboot_suggestion: Xipfalo xa USB COM a xi nga pfuriwi (xihoxo xa 1013). Ku sungula khompyuta ya wena nakambe swi ta humesa xipfalo lexi lotleriweke. Hi kombela u sungula khompyuta ya wena nakambe ivi u ringeta nakambe.
err_sp_enable_dram: Xitirhisiwa lexi a xi nga swi koti ku sungula ku tsundzuka ka mutlangi. Tirhisa phasela leri akiweke eka modele leyi kongomeke.
err_sp_storage_read: Xitirhisiwa lexi a xi nga swi koti ku hlaya vuhlayiselo bya mutlangi. Languta vuhlanganisi; xitirhisiwa xi nga ha va xi ri ni xihoxo xa hardware.
err_attempt_timeout: Xitirhisiwa xo voninga xi kombisile ku nga ri na nhluvuko ku nga si hela {seconds} wa tisekoni, kutani matshalatshala lawa ya yimisiwile.
err_connection_failed_desc: A swi swi kotanga ku simeka vuxaka lebyi tiyeke na mutlangi. Tiyisisa leswaku xitirhisiwa xi timiwile (tirhisa pini ku tshikilela buti ya reset loko swi laveka), susa USB, ivi u hlanganisa nakambe loko u komberiwa.
err_flash_write_failed_desc: Ku voninga ku kavanyetiwile kutani ntirho wo tsala wu tsandzekile. Languta leswaku khebulu ya USB yi nghenisiwile swinene naswona betri yi na chaji leyi eneleke, kutani u ringeta nakambe.
err_mtk_output_stall_desc: Xitirhisiwa xo voninga xi kombisile layini leyi fanaka eka tisekoni ta {seconds} to hetelela naswona a xi vonaki xi ya emahlweni xi tsala firmware. Swi nga ha endleka leswaku flash yi tsandzekile. Loko leswi a ku ri ro hetelela eka matshalatshala mambirhi na ndlela yin’wana na yin’wana eka sisiteme leyi nga tlhelelaka endzhaku exikarhi ka vona, kumbe loko ku ri na MTKClient ntsena leyi kumekaka eka muchini lowu, sungula khompyuta nakambe ivi u ringeta nakambe.
err_only_mtkclient_desc: I MTKClient ntsena leyi kumekaka eka ku nghenisa loku. Swi nga ha endleka leswaku flash yi tsandzekile. Hi kombela u sungula khompyuta nakambe ivi u ringeta nakambe.
err_mtk_output_stall_fallback_available: Khompyuta leyi yi nga tlhela yi nghenisa hi ku tirhisa SP Flash Tool. Loko u swi kota, cincela eka SP Flash Tool ivi u ringeta nakambe.
prompt_restart_and_quit_desc: Swi nga ha endleka leswaku flash yi tsandzekile. Hi kombela u hlaya rungula leri nga laha henhla ivi u sungula khompyuta nakambe u nga si ringeta nakambe. Loko u tsindziyela OK, app yi ta huma leswaku u ta kota ku sungula nakambe.
err_missing_package_files_title: Phasela ra Firmware leri nga tirhiki
err_missing_package_files_desc: Phasela ra firmware ri kayivela fayili ya ku hangalaka kumbe tifayela ta swifaniso leti lavekaka. Hi kombela u tlhela u dawuniloda phasela kutani u hlawula fayili ya firmware leyi heleleke.
err_auth_file_unusable_title: Fayili ya Vuhlayiseki A yi tirhisiwi
err_auth_file_unusable_desc: Fayili ya vuhlayiseki leyi u yi hlawuleke a yi kona, a yi na nchumu kumbe a yi swi kotanga ku tsariwa. Hlawula fayili leyi tirhaka, kutani u yi basisa eka Switirhisiwa, kutani u tlhela u flash.
err_tool_unavailable_title: Xitirhisiwa xo Flash A Xi Kumeki
err_tool_unavailable_desc: Xitirhisiwa xo voninga kumbe swichayachayani swa sisiteme leswi lavekaka a swi nga ta sunguriwa. Hi kombela u kambela mpfumelelo wa sisiteme, ku lulamisiwa ka muchayeri, kumbe u nghenisa xitirhisiwa nakambe.
err_driver_missing_desc: Xihoxo lexi xi nga humelela loko muchayeri wa USB wa MediaTek a nga nghenisiwanga. Click Download Drivers ku nghenisa MediaTek USB driver, sungula khompyuta ya wena nakambe, kutani u ringeta nakambe.
err_cache_file_missing_desc: Fayili ya firmware leyi hlayisiweke yi kayivela. Hlawula Hlawula Software ku tlhela u aka tifayela leti humesiweke kutani u kopa akhavhiyu ya firmware nakambe. Lexi i xiphiqo xa fayili ya laha kaya, hayi mhaka ya vuhlanganisi bya USB.
sel_cache_retry_tooltip: Vuya eka Hlawula Software ku aka nakambe kumbe ku kopa phasela ra firmware.
sel_cache_retry_select_release: Hlawula nkandziyiso wa firmware leswaku u dawuniloda nakambe.
err_generic_flash_failed_desc: Xihoxo lexi nga languteriwangiki xi humelerile hi nkarhi wa ku nghenisa ({detail}). Tima gezi ra xichayachayani hi ku helela, hlanganisa nakambe loko u komberiwa, ivi u ringeta nakambe.
flash_method_confirm: Ndlela yo nghenisa yi cinciwile yi va {method}. Tiyisisa leswaku xichayachayani xi humile eka pulagi naswona xi timiwile, kutani u tikhoma Next.
flash_failover_note: {method} a yi endlanga leswaku ku nghenisiwa ku sungula. Endzhaku ka loko xitlangi xi timiwile no pfuriwa gezi, ku ta tirhisiwa {other} ematshan’wini ya sweswo.
themepack_card_title: Nghenisa Xipaci xa Nhlokomhaka xa 360p Rockbox
themepack_card_desc: Ku katsa tinhlokomhaka to saseka ta vaaki, swifaniso swa le ndzhaku swa xiyimo xa le henhla, na tifonto leti endleriweke hi ku kongoma swikombiso swa 360p.
themepack_installed_success: 360p Theme Pack yi nghenisiwile hi ndlela leyi humelelaka!
themepack_dialog_title: Rockbox 360p Xiyimiso xa Xipaci xa Nhlokomhaka
themepack_step1_title: Goza 1: Hlanganisa eka USB Storage Mode
themepack_step1_desc:
1. Vulavula hi xichayachayani xa wena hi ku khoma buti ya Power.
2. Loko Rockbox yi sungula, nghenisa khebulu ya USB eka khompyuta ya wena.
3. Loko u komberiwa eka xikirini xa xichayachayani, tiyisisa movha wa Vuhlayiselo bya USB leswaku xitirhisiwa xi humelela tanihi drive.
themepack_step2_title: Goza 2: Hlawula Folda Yihi na Yihi eka Xichayachayani
themepack_step2_desc: Hikuva tisisiteme to tirha (ku fana na macOS) ti fihla ti dotfiles (ku fana na .rockbox) hi ku tiyimisela, u nga hlawula folda YIN’WANI na yin’wana kumbe rimitsu ra drive eka xichayachayani xa wena. Hi ta tikuma hi tisungulela kumbe hi ku endlela xikombo xa .rockbox.
themepack_complete: Theme pack yi nghenisiwile hi ndlela leyi humelelaka! Sweswi u nga ha tsema xichayachayani xa wena hi ku hlayiseka ivi u hlawula nhloko-mhaka eka Rockbox (Swiyimiso > Switirhisiwa swa Nhloko-mhaka).
themepack_err_not_found: A swi swi kotanga ku kuma kumbe ku sungula xikombo xa .rockbox eka drive leyi hlawuriweke. Hi kombela u tiyisisa leswaku u hlawurile folda eka xichayachayani xa wena.
rockbox_wizard_skip_adb: Tlula eka Mode ya Vuhlayiselo bya USB
rockbox_wizard_reboot_title: Goza 1: Sungula xichayachayani nakambe ivi u hlanganisa nakambe
rockbox_wizard_reboot_desc:
1. Hluvula khebulu ya USB.
2. Power player back on u yi tshika yi boot eka Rockbox.
3. Loko Rockbox yi tirha, hlanganisa cable ya USB nakambe, kutani u cinca Continue.
rockbox_wizard_adb_title: Goza 2: Ku lava mutlangi ehenhla ka ADB...
rockbox_wizard_adb_desc: App yi langutele vuhlanganisi bya ADB (ku fika eka 30 wa tisekoni). Loko xitirhisiwa xi kumiwile, tinhloko-mhaka ta hundziseriwa naswona xichayachayani xi pfuriwa nakambe hi xoxe. Handle ka sweswo, tlula emahlweni eka USB Storage Mode.
rockbox_wizard_adb_searching: Ku yimela xitirhisiwa xa ADB... (ku fika eka 30 wa tisekoni)
rockbox_wizard_adb_found: Xitirhisiwa lexi kumiweke ({serial}); ku hundzisela tinhlokomhaka...
rockbox_wizard_adb_timeout: Ku hava xitirhisiwa xa ADB lexi kumiweke ku nga si hela tisekoni ta 30; ku ya emahlweni hi Mode ya Vuhlayiselo bya USB.
rockbox_wizard_no_adb: Ku hava binary ya ADB leyi kumekaka eka app; ku ya emahlweni hi Mode ya Vuhlayiselo bya USB.
rockbox_wizard_adb_pushing: Ku susumeta tinhlokomhaka na tifonto eka ADB...
rockbox_wizard_adb_push_failed: Ku hundziseriwa ka ADB ku tsandzekile; ku wela endzhaku eka Mode ya Vuhlayiselo bya USB
rockbox_wizard_usb_title: Nghenisa hi ku tirhisa Mode ya Vuhlayiselo bya USB
rockbox_wizard_usb_desc:
1. Endla leswaku USB Storage Mode yi tirha eka xichayachayani leswaku yi humelela tanihi drive.
2. Hlawula folda YIN’WANI na yin’wana eka xichayachayani lexi nga laha hansi (.rockbox, Music, Themes, kumbe rimitsu ra drive, folda ya .rockbox leyi fihliweke yi kumeka hi ku tisungulela).
3. App yi hlanganisa tinhlokomhaka ta 360p na tifonto eka, yi tsala ehenhla ka tifayela ta mavito lama fanaka.
rockbox_wizard_done_desc: Sweswi u nga ha tsema xichayachayani hi ku hlayiseka ivi u hlawula theme eka Rockbox (Swiyimiso > Switirhisiwa swa Nhlokomhaka).
rockbox_stage_installing: Ku nghenisa Titheme & Tifonto ta Rockbox...
rockbox_cleanup_step: Ku susa swiyimiso swa khale swa Rockbox...
rockbox_cleanup_deleting: Ku susa folda ya .rockbox eka xichayachayani...
rockbox_cleanup_failed_note: Software ya wena leyintshwa yi nghenisiwile, kambe folda ya khale ya .rockbox a yi swi kotanga ku susiwa. Susa folda ya .rockbox eka xichayachayani hi voko loko u lava ku sungula loku tengeke.
rockbox_stage_waiting_adb_fmt: Ku lava mutlangi hi ku tirhisa ADB ({remaining}s)...
rockbox_stage_disconnect_extra: Vatlangi vo tlula un’we va hlanganisiwile. Hluvula leswin’wana ivi u siya ntsena leyi nghenisiweke.
rockbox_stage_pushing: Mutlangi u kumiwile. Ku veka tinhlokomhaka ta vaaki & tifonto...
rockbox_stage_pushing_files_fmt: Ku veka tifayela ta nhlokomhaka ({curr} ya {total})...
rockbox_wizard_reboot_desc_y1: Khoma buti ya le xikarhi ku pfula Y1 ya wena, u tlhela u hlanganisa USB, ivi u hlawula USB Storage Mode.
rockbox_wizard_reboot_desc_power: Khoma buti ya gezi ku pfula xichayachayani xa wena, u tlhela u hlanganisa USB, ivi u hlawula Mode ya Vuhlayiselo bya USB.
rockbox_recover_troubleshoot: Xitirhisiwa a xi sunguli? Vuyisela software yo sungula
rockbox_step1_disconnect_power_on: Hi kombela u tsema vuhlanganisi u tlhela u pfula {model} ya wena, kutani u tshikelela Next
rockbox_step1_power_on_button: Hluvula USB, khoma {button} ku pfula {model} ya wena, kutani u cinca Next.
rockbox_step_standalone_power_on_usb: Hlanganisa {model} ya wena hi USB, yi pfula gezi, kutani u tshikelela Next.
rockbox_step_select_rockbox_folder: Hi kombela u hlawula xitlangi hi xoxe kumbe folda ya .rockbox

rockbox_step2_connect_usb: Hi kombela u hlanganisa {model} ya wena hi USB
rockbox_step_usb_storage_mode: Hi kombela u pfumelela movha wa vuhlayiselo bya USB eka xitirhisiwa xa wena ivi u tikhoma Next
rockbox_step_usb_storage_folder: Hi kombela u pfumelela movha wa vuhlayiselo bya USB eka {model} ya wena, kutani u hlawula drive leyi humelelaka
rockbox_step_select_player_folder: Hi kombela u hlawula xichayachayani hi xoxe kumbe yin’wana ya tifolda leti nga eka xona
rockbox_power_on_prompt_sp_y1: Hluvula USB na gezi eka Y1 ya wena, kutani u cinca Next.
rockbox_power_on_prompt_sp_other: Hluvula USB na gezi eka {model} ya wena, kutani u tshikelela Next.
rockbox_ask_running_fmt: Xana Rockbox yi tirha hi {model} ya wena?
rockbox_manual_guide:
1. Hlawula 'USB Storage Mode' eka xichayachayani xa wena.
2. Click 'Browse Folder...' ku hlawula player ya wena na ku nghenisa ti themes.
rockbox_site_themes_note: Ku aka loku ka Rockbox ku tirhisa tinhlokomhaka ta 240×320, leti nga hlanganisiwangiki. Kuma tinhlokomhaka ta mahala ta mutlangi wa wena ku suka eka sayiti ya nhlokomhaka ya Rockbox:
rockbox_site_themes_open: Pfula sayiti ya nhlokomhaka ya Rockbox
rockbox_troubleshoot_desc: Loko {model} ya wena yi nga pfuli, tsema USB, khoma buti ya gezi ku ringana 10s ku tlhela yi seta, ivi u pfula gezi. Kumbe u vuyisela software ya masungulo.
err_storage_full_title: A ku na ndhawu leyi eneleke ya disk
err_storage_full_desc: Khompyuta ya wena yi heleriwe hi ndhawu yo hlayisa swilo. Hi kombela u ntshunxa ndhawu ya disk eka drive ya wena ivi u ringeta nakambe.
err_usb_lost_subtitle: Xana u nga tsakela ku ringeta nakambe?
legacy_cleanup_desc: Vuhundzuluxeri bya khale bya Updater bya ha ri eka khompyuta leyi naswona byi teka ndhawu ya disk. Ku yi susa swi ntshunxa ndhawu yoleyo.
legacy_cleanup_reclaim: Ku vuyisa kwalomu ka {size} ya ndhawu ya disk
legacy_cleanup_remove_app_cb: Susa tifolda ta khale ta xitirhisiwa xa Innioasis Updater na nseketelo
legacy_cleanup_keep_platform_tools_cb: Hlayisa Switirhisiwa swa Pulatifomo ya Android (ADB / Fastboot) swi nghenisiwile
legacy_cleanup_platform_tools_hint: Loko u nga tirhisi ADB kumbe Fastboot ehandle ka Updater, susa xikombo ku susa na ku vuyisa vuhlayiselo byo engetela.
legacy_cleanup_done_msg: Ku basisiwa hi ku humelela ku nghenisiwa ka ndzhaka na ndhawu ya disk leyi vuyeleriweke.
donate_completion_subtitle_the_software: Software yi nghenisiwile eka {model} ya wena.
legacy_cleanup_card_desc: Vuhundzuluxeri bya khale bya Updater bya ha ri eka khompyuta leyi. Ku yi susa swi ntshunxa ndhawu ya disk.
legacy_cleanup_none_found: Ku hava vuhundzuluxeri bya khale lebyi kumiweke.
legacy_cleanup_confirm_body: Leswi swi susa hi ku helela app ya khale, firmware leyi dawunilodiweke ni tifayela leti saleke.
legacy_cleanup_tools_body: Susa Switirhisiwa swa Pulatifomo ya Android (ADB / Fastboot) na swona? Hlawula Hlayisa loko u tirhisa ADB.
legacy_cleanup_done_inline: Ku susiwile, kwalomu ka {size} ku ntshunxiwile.
log_btn_goto_file_tip: Paluxa fayili ya log eka Finder / Explorer
log_btn_save_file_tip: Rhumela ehandle fayili ya log leyi kombisiweke eka disk
log_btn_copy_tip: Kopa log leyi kombisiweke eka clipboard
log_revealed_in_file_manager_fmt: Ku paluxiwile eka mufambisi wa fayili: {name}
update_start_failed_fmt: A swi koteki ku sungula ku pfuxetiwa: {error}

settings_arm64_driver_note: Nseketelo wa ARM64 Windows a wu kamberiwanga. Eka tilaptop ta Snapdragon na RTX Spark, Zadig yi nga tirhisiwa na Driver Signature Enforcement leyi nga tirhiki ku nghenisa WinUSB kumbe libusb ya xitirhisiwa xa MT6227 Preloader eka Device Manager. Vona nkongomiso wa muchayeri wa ARM64 ku kuma magoza.
keep_data_which_firmware_fmt: Hi yihi software leyi tirhaka sweswi eka {model} ya wena?
